set.body:
Owner direction, 2026-09-27: eyes4s should be generally better than pymovements in design, performance, elegance and visualization. Deliver that outcome through five independently evidenced workstreams: complete workflows, first-use usability, comparative performance, visualization, and empirical scientific validation.

Starting evidence: preliminary inspection of eyes4s fa6fa0ec48c236b6e70e49bfc6809c7bcc802102 and published pymovements 0.28.0 (PyPI source revision fe333f3afa862ae3fc7056047a1a929798cfe18b). This is an assessment baseline, not a qualification. Recheck and pin the comparison at the first slice; refresh version drift before final acceptance without silently replacing the frozen benchmark.

Acceptance:
1. Complete comparable raw-recording, reading/AOI and fixation-study journeys through admission, quality assessment, preprocessing, detection, measures, figures, export and saved/reloaded analysis. Promote reading and data quality into this epic's required coverage. Preserve eyes4s' distinctive comparative-study strengths.
2. A researcher can install and complete a first real analysis with a short verified guide, accessible data, understandable diagnostics and explicit scientific choices. Demonstrate usability against the comparable pymovements task.
3. Demonstrate meaningful measured performance gains and no material regressions across the declared common workload matrix. Include ingestion, transforms, detectors, quality/reading, complete pipelines, allocation and retained memory, startup and UI responsiveness. A benchmark harness or descriptive report alone cannot close this target.
4. Deliver a same-data visualization gallery with scientific accuracy, legibility, accessible interaction and publication exports. Evaluate standalone library use and real Studio workflows separately; designs and mock backends cannot qualify the application.
5. Execute human-annotated and independent-reference validation with frozen conventions, matching, splits, metrics and scientific thresholds. Demonstrate accuracy/robustness rather than treating type safety or agreement with a software oracle as empirical truth.

Closure: all five child gates meet their predeclared acceptance criteria, with an explicit capability/evidence matrix, clean source SHA and tree, input/configuration hashes, reproducible commands, raw measurements, platform/environment and limitations. Report ties and losses; a win in one area cannot compensate for an unmet major area. Missing required coverage remains open. Any scope reduction or relaxed superiority threshold requires an explicit owner decision recorded in Mote; do not retrofit thresholds to results.

Design constraints: typed units and frame/clock agreement, explicit missingness/exclusions, pure library boundaries, versioned plans/provenance, truthful mathematical interfaces and JVM/JS conformance survive convenience and optimization work. Python is permitted in offline comparison tooling, not as a required eyes4s runtime. Reuse current API, detector-validation and Studio owners; no duplicate implementations or reassignment. Workstreams are epics/gates; implementation slices must be independently reviewable and about half a day or less, with regression/law evidence appropriate to the change and normal repository landing gates. This adds a comparative acceptance objective without silently rewriting the existing core-release scope.

Sources: https://pymovements.readthedocs.io/en/stable/index.html ; https://pypi.org/project/pymovements/ ; eyes4s.md ; PRD.md ; tools/detector-conformance/README.md ; tools/detector-benchmark/README.md ; docs/formats/eyelink-asc.md ; docs/studio/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.
set.title: Demonstrate eyes4s leadership over pymovements in all five major research areas
